name: FloorAtom
header: abbrev FloorAtom := Fin 200 ⊕ Fin 201

name: floorGrid
header: def floorGrid (j : ℕ) : ℝ := 1 + (j : ℝ) / 50

name: floorValue
header: def floorValue (nums : Fin 200 → ℤ) (i : Fin 200) : ℝ := (nums i : ℝ) / (2 ^ 80 : ℝ)

name: floorKnotValue
floorAtomValue
header:
def floorAtomValue (nums : Fin 200 → ℤ) : FloorAtom → ℝ
  | .inl i => floorValue nums i
  | .inr j => floorKnotValue nums j

name: floorAtomSet
measurableSet_floorAtomSet
header: theorem measurableSet_floorAtomSet (b : FloorAtom) : MeasurableSet (floorAtomSet b)

name: floorStep
header:
def floorStep (nums : Fin 200 → ℤ) (s : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  ∑ b : FloorAtom, (floorAtomSet b).indicator (fun _ => floorAtomValue nums b) s

name: floorBound
header: def floorBound (nums : Fin 200 → ℤ) : ℝ := ∑ b : FloorAtom, ‖floorAtomValue nums b‖

name: floor_atom_count
header: theorem floor_atom_count : Fintype.card FloorAtom = 401

name: measurable_floorStep
header: theorem measurable_floorStep (nums : Fin 200 → ℤ) : Measurable (floorStep nums)

name: floorStep_outside
header:
theorem floorStep_outside (nums : Fin 200 → ℤ) {s : ℝ} (hs : s ∉ Icc (2 : ℝ) 5) :
    floorStep nums s = 0

name: norm_floorStep_le
header:
theorem norm_floorStep_le (nums : Fin 200 → ℤ) (s : ℝ) :
    ‖floorStep nums s‖ ≤ floorBound nums

name: floorBound_nonneg
header: theorem floorBound_nonneg (nums : Fin 200 → ℤ) : 0 ≤ floorBound nums

name: pulledFloorAtom
header: def pulledFloorAtom (b : FloorAtom) : Set (Fin 2 → ℝ) := argument ⁻¹' floorAtomSet b

name: measurableSet_pulledFloorAtom
header: theorem measurableSet_pulledFloorAtom (b : FloorAtom) : MeasurableSet (pulledFloorAtom b)

name: correctionWeight
header: def correctionWeight (x : Fin 2 → ℝ) : ℝ := (4 / residual x) * ∏ i, 1 / x i

name: continuousOn_correctionWeight_closedTriangle
header:
theorem continuousOn_correctionWeight_closedTriangle :
    ContinuousOn correctionWeight closedTriangle

name: integrableOn_correctionWeight
header: theorem integrableOn_correctionWeight : IntegrableOn correctionWeight triangle

name: original_denominator_margins
header:
theorem original_denominator_margins {x : Fin 2 → ℝ} (hx : x ∈ triangle) :
    (34 / 125 : ℝ) ≤ residual x ∧ a ≤ x 0 ∧ a ≤ x 1

name: atomCorrection
header:
def atomCorrection (nums : Fin 200 → ℤ) (b : FloorAtom) (x : Fin 2 → ℝ) : ℝ :=
  floorAtomValue nums b * (pulledFloorAtom b).indicator correctionWeight x

name: correction_eq_finite_sum
header:
theorem correction_eq_finite_sum (nums : Fin 200 → ℤ) (x : Fin 2 → ℝ) :
    floorStep nums (argument x) * correctionWeight x =
      ∑ b : FloorAtom, atomCorrection nums b x

name: integrableOn_atomCorrection
header:
theorem integrableOn_atomCorrection (nums : Fin 200 → ℤ) (b : FloorAtom) :
    IntegrableOn (atomCorrection nums b) triangle

name: integrableOn_floorCorrection
header:
theorem integrableOn_floorCorrection (nums : Fin 200 → ℤ) :
    IntegrableOn (fun x => floorStep nums (argument x) * correctionWeight x) triangle

name: weightedKernel_eq_base_add_floor
header:
theorem weightedKernel_eq_base_add_floor (nums : Fin 200 → ℤ) (x : Fin 2 → ℝ) :
    kernel (floorStep nums) x * (∏ i, 1 / x i) =
      kernel (fun _ => 0) x * (∏ i, 1 / x i) +
        floorStep nums (argument x) * correctionWeight x

name: integrableOn_floorKernel
header:
theorem integrableOn_floorKernel (nums : Fin 200 → ℤ) :
    IntegrableOn (fun x => kernel (floorStep nums) x * ∏ i, 1 / x i) triangle

name: integral_floor_finite_fubini
header:
theorem integral_floor_finite_fubini (nums : Fin 200 → ℤ) :
    integral (floorStep nums) = integral (fun _ => 0) +
      ∑ b : FloorAtom, floorAtomValue nums b *
        ∫ x in triangle ∩ pulledFloorAtom b, correctionWeight x

name: floorAtom_integral_nested
header:
theorem floorAtom_integral_nested (b : FloorAtom) :
    (∫ x in triangle ∩ pulledFloorAtom b, correctionWeight x) =
      ∫ u : ℝ, ∫ t : ℝ,
        (triangle ∩ pulledFloorAtom b).indicator correctionWeight ![u, t]

name: integral_floor_nested_fubini
header:
theorem integral_floor_nested_fubini (nums : Fin 200 → ℤ) :
    integral (floorStep nums) = integral (fun _ => 0) +
      ∑ b : FloorAtom, floorAtomValue nums b *
        ∫ u : ℝ, ∫ t : ℝ,
          (triangle ∩ pulledFloorAtom b).indicator correctionWeight ![u, t]

name: integral_floor_split_log_canonical
header:
theorem integral_floor_split_log_canonical (nums : Fin 200 → ℤ) :
    integral (floorStep nums) =
      (∫ x in firstRegion,
        (4 * (Real.log (argument x - 1) + floorStep nums (argument x)) / residual x) *
          ∏ i, 1 / x i) +
      ∫ x in secondRegion, canonicalKernel (floorStep nums) x * ∏ i, 1 / x i

name: adoptedH248Floor
header: def adoptedH248Floor : ℝ → ℝ := floorStep adoptedH248Numerators

name: measurable_adoptedH248Floor
header: theorem measurable_adoptedH248Floor : Measurable adoptedH248Floor

name: norm_adoptedH248Floor_le
header:
theorem norm_adoptedH248Floor_le (s : ℝ) :
    ‖adoptedH248Floor s‖ ≤ floorBound adoptedH248Numerators

name: integrableOn_adoptedH248Kernel
header:
theorem integrableOn_adoptedH248Kernel :
    IntegrableOn (fun x => kernel adoptedH248Floor x * ∏ i, 1 / x i) triangle

name: adoptedH248_integral_finite_fubini
header:
theorem adoptedH248_integral_finite_fubini :
    integral adoptedH248Floor = integral (fun _ => 0) +
      ∑ b : FloorAtom, floorAtomValue adoptedH248Numerators b *
        ∫ x in triangle ∩ pulledFloorAtom b, correctionWeight x
